موافقة تاريخ: 17 Dec 2006

تاريخ ليكون 
 تمت المراجعة: Dec 2011
مقدمة

This document outlines the maintenance procedures 
P1, 
which should be carried out every three years as indicated by Y3 in the title 
block.

The technical specification of the hydro unit: 
Francis Turbine max. power 180MW, max head 75m, speed 100 RPM, Woodward 
governor.

The first draft 
was initiated by eng. Mohamed Abd Allah Ismaiel, tested by eng. Atef Sadeq 
Sayed, accepted by eng. Ahmed Saber Gabr: general director, approved by eng. 
Abdel-Karem Abu Zid: head sector of High Dam power station, and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control general 
director & MPIS coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety ID category.
Wear safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask safety glass ...etc

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل 
 is required.

Completely 
 empty the tunnel

Water level 
 at draft tube not exceed 100m.

Secure 
 closing intake and draft tubes maintenance gates.

افتح 
 بوابات الويكيت تصل إلى 100%.

Switch off 
 F403 automatic.

Close the 
 main oil valve no.7.

Release 
 pressure of the oil pressure unit MHY to zero.
باستخدام رافعة علوية 400 طن
Using lightening 36 V
Using 8 bar service air

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Turbine bearing

Dismantle the 
waved iron round the bearing, to inspect the bath & housing of the turbine 
bearing and also all the pipe line connections, oil cooler to detect the 
leakages

Drain oil first 
from 1 oil - cooling compartment of the turbine bearing, then from the 2-d one; 
to dismantle the upper bath cover and thermo controlling scheme; to make the 
formular no 4 of gaps on bearing & on the shaft position corresponding to the 
adjustment marks

Left all 
the segment on the butt of the bearing neck, to carry out the examination of 
state of babbit surface of the segment & working surface of the neck

If it is 
necessary to carry out the scraping of the babbit surface

Check up the 
tightening of the fastening of the upper bath, the connections of the upper 
located circulating pipes, the lock - nuts of the screw - down bolts

If the 
tightening of the lock - nuts with the thread 3" is slacked, to check up the 
fixation of the thread bushes in the bearing housing & take the measures for 
their reliable fixing in the housing

Check up the 
safety of all the pins

Dismantle the 
lower circulating pipes, to lower the lower located bath on 4 stubs L=440 mm

Clean the bath 
from the oil sediment & durt, to lift & assemble the bath & to connect the pipes

Dismantle 2 oil 
- coolers of the bearing

Clean the oil - 
coolers from the oil - sediment & durt the oil - cooler compartments

Inspect the 
packing rubber on oil - coolers

مسح والمحاكمة 
يتم تبريد الزيت بضغط 8 جو لمدة 10 دقائق قبل وضعه 
تركيب مبردات الزيت، لتوصيل خطوط الأنابيب، لتجربة جميع التوصيلات 
ضغط الماء من مصدر الحريق (5atm)

Install the 
segments, to adjust the gaps & to make the formular no. 7 of gaps together with 
E.T.L. to check up the operation of the thermo control of the bearing

Eliminate all 
the rest detected remarks and faults of the bearing

Fill bearing 
with pure oil to secure the normal oil level (190 mm from the support ring of 
the segments)

Check up 
together with E.T.L. the operation of oil level relay and presence of the signal

Install the 
protective grating and waved iron round turbine bearing
